task.title: To make a clause smart in a template

step.cmd: Open the template in X-Author Contracts.
Log in to X-Author Contracts and from the left-hand navigation select X-Author Templates.
In the X-Author Templates pane, go to Work >Template Clauses.
The Template Clauses pane lists all the clauses present in your template. Select a clause from the list and click the gear icon next to the clause name
In the Properties pane, slide the switch to turn on the Smart Clause attribute and click Ok.

postreq.p: Your template clause will now have smartness property. To remove the smartness property of a clause, you can slide the Smart Clause attribute switch to off position (greyed out).
